resources.notes: Provided as a JSON or text file within the task package.

access.notes: Coordinates from an ab initio Hartree-Fock study. The slab comprises 8 bi-layers (32 atoms) with surface relaxation.

resources.name: sp3s* tight-binding implementation

access.notes: The solving agent must implement the sp³s* Hamiltonian, optical matrix elements including intra-atomic dipoles, and the dielectric response formulas. Standard Python with NumPy is sufficient.

resources.notes: No specific existing package is mandated; the agent may write its own code.
